audit.why: 54.73% over 349 games, and this is the only matchup in my slice the packet reports with zero defects and zero suspect names. The chart gives Camille everything except the two Skill stages, and the prose is honest that a 1-3-1 with Maiden up beats her — the lane is won, the game is not automatically won. Nothing to move.

audit.whatIsWrong: Yorick's ultimate is referred to only by the summon it produces — 'Maiden of the Mist', 'before Maiden exists', 'once Maiden is up'. The ability is Eulogy of the Isles and its cooldown never appears.
audit.why: Eulogy of the Isles is 160s at rank 1, dropping to 100s at rank 3 — the longest cooldown in either kit. That number is the whole side-lane plan the late section describes: a Yorick who has just spent Maiden and lost her is not a split threat again for well over two minutes, which is the window Camille is supposed to be taking towers in. Naming only the summon hides the fact that there is a timer on it at all.
audit.corrected: Eulogy of the Isles named with its 160s cooldown in spikes[3].text and late.

audit.whatIsWrong: Last Rites is named once in spikes[0].text and never explained; Shepherd of Souls never appears; Camille's R is written as 'R drops the Hextech arena' rather than by name. Mourning Mist is treated purely as a slow-and-mark.
audit.why: Two mechanics are missing that change how the lane is played. First, Last Rites is an auto-attack reset that heals Yorick — Riot flags both — on 6s at rank 1 down to 4s. That makes the wind-up the tell for his burst rather than the cast, and it makes Grievous Wounds the item that decides extended trades; _missing-interactions.json flags both for this exact pairing and neither reaches the page. Second, Riot flags Mourning Mist as a dash: it does not merely mark you for the ghouls, it lets Yorick close on the marked target himself. A player told to 'bait or sidestep E so his ghouls don't leap' is being warned about half of it.
audit.corrected: Last Rites stated as a 6s healing auto-reset with the wind-up named as the tell; the Grievous Wounds cue added; Mourning Mist's own gap-close written in; Shepherd of Souls named as the ghoul-grave passive; R given its full name.
sources: champ-data/_kits/yorick.json (Q heal + autoReset, E dash flag)

audit.whatIsWrong: 'While his E (Mourning Mist) is on cooldown' and 'force fights while his E is on cooldown' name the punishable cooldown twice without giving it.
audit.why: Mourning Mist is 12s at rank 1 down to 8s, against Hookshot's 16s. His engage-and-mark is back before her engage is, which means the instruction to fight inside its downtime costs her tempo to obey — worth knowing before you sit on a 16s cooldown waiting for a 12s one. Dark Procession, at 20s, is the longer and more punishable one.
audit.corrected: Mourning Mist's 12s and Dark Procession's 20s written in.

audit.whatIsWrong: Dark Procession is described as a wall that traps Camille — 'boxing you in with his W wall', 'his W wall can box you in mid-engage'.
audit.why: Riot flags Dark Procession as terrain, and Hookshot requires terrain to anchor to. His cage is therefore also a grapple point in the middle of open lane — the same interaction the already-audited Trundle mirror establishes for Pillar of Ice. It genuinely traps her when it lands around her, but a cage dropped to zone her from outside hands her the engage she otherwise lacks in open ground.
audit.corrected: Written into whys[5] as a two-sided fact rather than a pure threat.

Last-hit at range and wait for your level 2-3 spike. Once you have your Q recast (the second hit's bonus true damage) and a point in W, your percent-HP slash and self-heal win every short trade before he can stack four ghoul graves, and his only real kill threat is catching you with E into his ghoul swarm or boxing you in with his W wall.

Once you have your Q recast (the second hit's bonus true damage) and a point in W, your percent-HP slash and self-heal win every short trade before Shepherd of Souls banks four graves — just watch the Last Rites wind-up, because that 6s auto-reset heals him straight through your chip.

No Maiden yet, so your trades stick — but Last Rites heals a chunk back every 6s, so bring Grievous Wounds. notes: This was the cleanest matchup in the slice — the packet reports no defects and no suspect names — so the work here is additive rather than corrective. Two things _missing-interactions.json flags were absent: Last Rites is a healing auto-attack reset (so the wind-up is the burst tell, and Grievous Wounds decides long trades), and it is his only real sustain before Maiden. Riot also flags Mourning Mist as a dash, meaning it closes the gap as well as marking her — the matchup described only the mark. Finally, Dark Procession is terrain, which by the same logic as the Trundle mirror makes it a grapple anchor for Hookshot when he drops it to zone rather than to cage; the text treated it purely as a trap.
